title: Twin Showdown
next_chapter_hook: When the blood-colored seal finally shattered, Chen Ji saw the true purpose of that sacrifice ten thousand years ago—Cang Yutian's every action had been to prevent the birth of an existence capable of overthrowing the Heavenly Dao.

text.content: When that familiar oppressive sensation descended once more, Chen Ji knew the Demonic Path Commander's patience had run out—and this time, he would witness another branch of his fate. Black demonic clouds surged like a tide, the Demonic Path Commander's figure looming indistinct within them, surrounded by the same purple-golden radiance as Chen Ji, only far more violent and distorted. "Waste." The Demonic Path Commander's voice was ice-cold. "You think obtaining the Tianji Record lets you oppose me? Between us, it isn't just the Heavenly Fate Value that differs." Chen Ji slowly lifted his head, his pupils reflecting that lofty figure, yet a cold smirk curved his lips—he had waited for this moment for a long time.

dialogue.content: "What differs isn't the Heavenly Fate Value." Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm. "It's conscience." He slowly drew the sword at his waist, its blade flowing with purple-golden light from the same source as the Tianji Record. "But you don't even have that."

"Hahaha!" The Demonic Path Commander threw his head back in laughter, the sound filled with mockery. "Conscience? In this dog-eat-dog world, conscience only makes you die faster! That person ten thousand years ago was too naive, which is why he was split apart, abandoned, and—" He suddenly stopped, a complex light flickering in his eyes.

text.content: Before his words finished, Chen Ji had already moved. His form became an afterimage, his sword light like a falling Milky Way, directly aiming for the Demonic Path Commander's throat. This strike had no flashy techniques, only the purest speed and power—and the anger suppressed for who knows how long. The Demonic Path Commander slightly tilted his body, easily dodging, but a solemn light flashed in his eyes: "Interesting, it seems Tianqing Sect hasn't raised you for nothing these years."

dialogue.content: "Raised?" Chen Ji coldly laughed. "I, Chen Ji, swept floors for three years at Tianqing Sect, carried water for three years, fed spiritual beasts for three years—which bit of it wasn't earned by my own effort?" His sword momentum grew faster with each strike, each one carrying boundless hatred. "As for you, Demonic Path Commander—how does it feel to be used as a dog by the Holy Sect?"

text.content: A flash of fury appeared in the Demonic Path Commander's eyes, but was quickly suppressed. He waved his hand, and a black demonic energy transformed into a giant palm, slapping down toward Chen Ji. "Had enough talking?" His voice was ice-cold. "Let me see what worth this so-called 'same origin' of yours truly has!" Purple-golden and black light violently collided in the air, erupting with earth-shaking thunder. The ground within a hundred zhang instantly shattered, boulders flew everywhere, and dust filled the sky.

dialogue.content: "Same origin?" Chen Ji wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, a trace of confusion flickering in his eyes. From that strike, he truly felt some kind of strange resonance—like looking in a mirror, yet filled with unfamiliarity. "What do you mean by that?"

"See for yourself." The Demonic Path Commander coldly laughed, drawing a strange rune in the void with his finger. The rune shattered, and countless fragmented images flooded into Chen Ji's Mental Sea like a tide—a chaotic void, a solitary figure standing between heaven and earth, surrounded by the complete Tianji Record.

text.content: A thunderclap exploded in Chen Ji's mind. He saw it—ten thousand years ago, that figure discovered the ultimate secret of the Tianji Record: when the Tianji Record unified and the Twin Fates merged, an existence capable of threatening the Heavenly Dao's will would be born. The Eye of Heavenly Dao raged, ordering that figure completely erased. But the Tianji Record's will protected its master, splitting him into good and evil bodies—one infused with Heavenly Fate Value to become the Tianji Record's vessel, the other infused with demonic energy to become an eternal opposition. And the one who designed all this was an existence named "Cang Yutian."

dialogue.content: "No..." Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly; he refused to believe the images in his mind. "This is impossible!" But a corner of his heart knew everything was true. His Tianji Record fragments, his purple-golden True Qi, his keen intuition for fate—all came from the same source. And that source now stood before him, watching him with eyes full of hatred.

choice.prompt: The truth of the memories crashed against Chen Ji's Mental Sea like monstrous waves, and he had to make a choice—the anger made him want to destroy this "other half" forcibly created by fate, but some deep-rooted resonance buried in his heart prevented him from striking a killing blow.

choices.description: Regardless of the truth, this "other half" controlled by fate is still his enemy. Use battle to end battle, prove everything with strength.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Partial True Qi from the Demonic Path Commander
choices.risk_hint: The opponent's strength is comparable to his own; defeating them head-on would cost dearly

text.content: A decisive light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes, the Tianji Record疯狂旋转 in his Mental Sea, and purple-golden radiance exploded from his body. "Since fate insists on separating us—" His voice was ice-cold. "Then I'll use my sword to sever this damnable chains!" Sword light surged, carrying the momentum to destroy all before it, slashing down toward the Demonic Path Commander.

choices.description: Since we were originally one, why must we be forcibly separated by fate? Perhaps merging into one can break this ten-thousand-year curse.
choices.risk_hint: The fusion process is extremely dangerous; failure could result in soul destruction

text.content: Chen Ji slowly withdrew his sword stance and extended his hand toward the Demonic Path Commander. "We were originally one." His voice carried a strange calm. "Ten thousand years of opposition is enough." The Demonic Path Commander froze, his extended hand stopping mid-air, a moment of hesitation flickering in his eyes—the instinctive longing of someone who was abandoned.

choices.description: Cang Yutian's conspiracy cannot remain hidden. Expose everything to let everyone know they were used as chess pieces.
choices.visible_reward: May Gain Support from Third-Party Forces
choices.risk_hint: The truth is too shocking and may trigger even greater chaos

text.content: "Cang Yutian!" Chen Ji's voice rang like thunder. "You think splitting us lets you forever control the chessboard? Ten thousand years ago you designed all this—today I will let the entire cultivation world know your true colors!" His voice transmitted through the Tianji Record across a hundred li, and the entire battlefield fell silent.

At that moment, an ancient yet commanding voice drifted from the void: "Interesting, very interesting." That voice carried a strange rhythm, as if appreciating a meticulously arranged performance. "Ten thousand years, and finally someone has reached this step." Chen Ji and the Demonic Path Commander looked up simultaneously, seeing a blurred figure flickering in the void, surrounded by countless threads of fate—Cang Yutian's remnant projection.

dialogue.content: "Cang Yutian!" Chen Ji ground his teeth. "You designed our separation just for this damnable chess game?" That ancient voice laughed, the sound filled with mockery: "Child, your very existence is the chess game. Without opposing pieces, how can the game be played? Good and evil, light and darkness, justice and evil—these are the laws by which the Heavenly Dao operates."

text.content: Chen Ji felt a chill run through him. Ten thousand years, he had thought himself fate's favored one, never imagining he was a chess piece controlled from the beginning. And the Demonic Path Commander—that "other half" of his—was likewise merely a piece on the board. Fury, humiliation, unwillingness... various emotions churned in Chen Ji's chest, nearly overwhelming him. But he didn't explode, because he knew—anger only makes one lose rationality, and a piece that loses rationality can never overturn the chessboard.

choice.prompt: Cang Yutian's remnant projection floated in the void, countless threads of fate winding around his fingertips. Chen Ji had to make a choice—whether to continue opposing the Demonic Path Commander or join forces against this true幕后黑手.

choices.description: Cang Yutian is indeed detestable, but the enemy before me is also the mastermind who has oppressed me for ten thousand years. Deal with the immediate threat first, then handle the distant one.
choices.visible_reward: Thoroughly Defeat the Demonic Path Commander
choices.risk_hint: May Be Powerless Against Cang Yutian After Both Sides Are Wounded

dialogue.content: "Cang Yutian, wait." Chen Ji took a deep breath, temporarily suppressing his hatred toward Cang Yutian. "But now, I must first deal with this 'me'." He raised his sword once more, the purple-golden light even more brilliant than before.

choices.description: Cang Yutian is the true enemy. Since fate insists on separating us, let's resist this unjust fate together!
choices.visible_reward: Establish a Fragile Alliance with the Demonic Path Commander
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path Commander May Turn Traitor at Any Moment

dialogue.content: "We're both chess pieces." Chen Ji turned to the Demonic Path Commander, his voice calm. "But now, I'm tired of being manipulated. What about you?" The Demonic Path Commander was silent for a moment, then let out a disdainful laugh: "Don't think this makes me forgive you—" But his hand had already slowly lowered.

"Join forces?" Cang Yutian's voice carried playful interest. "Interesting, very interesting. But do you think two measly split souls can oppose the laws of the Heavenly Dao?" His figure suddenly expanded, countless threads of fate transforming into chains, wrapping toward both of them. "Since you refuse to continue the game—then perish together!"

text.content: Chen Ji and the Demonic Path Commander struck simultaneously, purple-golden and black light intertwining, somehow producing a strange resonance. That resonance grew stronger, gradually forming a brilliant pillar of light shooting straight into the clouds. The Tianji Record trembled wildly at this moment, countless ancient runes pouring from Chen Ji's body, forming a bridge between him and the Demonic Path Commander. "This is..." For the first time, uncertainty appeared in the Demonic Path Commander's voice, "Twin Resonance?"

dialogue.content: "Ten thousand years." Chen Ji's voice was low. "We were separated for ten thousand years, forced to oppose each other for ten thousand years, used as chess pieces for ten thousand years." His eyes burned with raging flames. "But today, I will let Cang Yutian know—" He and the Demonic Path Commander simultaneously clenched their fists, the two lights converging between their fists into a brilliant orb of light. "Chess pieces abandoned by fate can also overturn the chessboard!"

choice.prompt: The brilliant orb formed by Twin Resonance contained world-destroying power, but simultaneously consumed Chen Ji's Heavenly Fate Value frantically. Cang Yutian's chains of fate were approaching; he had to make a decision in an instant—whether to bet everything and release all his power, or conserve his strength for other opportunities.

choices.description: Release all Twin Resonance power at once, shattering Cang Yutian's remnant projection in one blow. The cost is depleted Heavenly Fate Value.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate Value Reduced to Zero
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate Value Reaching Zero May Lead to Unforeseeable Consequences

text.content: The orb erupted violently, transforming into a pillar of light piercing through heaven and earth, striking toward Cang Yutian's remnant. That ancient figure let out an angry roar in the light: "Impossible! How could you—" Before the words finished, the remnant completely shattered under Twin Resonance's power, dissolving into countless motes of light scattered across the void.

choices.description: Cang Yutian's remnant is merely a projection; the true threat still lurks in the shadows. Preserve Twin Resonance's power for the future.
choices.visible_cost: Give Up the Chance to Destroy the Remnant
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian Will Continue Plotting from the Shadows

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the resonance force within his body, and the orb of light slowly dissipated. Cang Yutian's remnant let out a sharp laugh: "As expected, you ultimately didn't dare risk everything. No matter, the chess game continues—" The voice gradually faded, but that icy threat lingered like a shadow.

The battle ended. The Demonic Path Commander stood in place, his surrounding demonic energy much lighter than before; his gaze toward Chen Ji held more complexity. "Today's matter, I've noted it." His voice was hoarse. "But don't expect my gratitude—you're still my enemy when next we meet." With that, his figure transformed into black smoke, vanishing into the void. Chen Ji didn't stop him, merely watching quietly as the other departed. He knew this confrontation was merely the beginning; the true chess game was far from over.

"Twin showdown, shared destiny's contest." Chen Ji murmured to himself, the Tianji Record slowly emerging in his Mental Sea, revealing a page of content he had never seen—a segment sealed for ten thousand years, recording the true purpose of that ancient sacrifice. "Cang Yutian..." Chen Ji tightly clenched his fists. "You think splitting us lets you control everything, but you forgot one thing—when chess pieces abandoned by fate awaken, they become more insane than anyone." He raised his head, gazing toward the distant漆黑 sky, his eyes burning with unyielding flames.

The Tianji Record turned pages, and a new page slowly appeared—the complete record of that sacrifice ten thousand years ago. When Chen Ji clearly saw its contents, his pupils sharply contracted—so Cang Yutian's every action hadn't been to maintain Heavenly Dao's balance, but to prevent an even more terrifying existence from being born: when the Tianji Record unified and the twins merged, a "Freed One" capable of completely escaping Heavenly Dao's control would be born. And that existence's prototype was precisely that figure split apart ten thousand years ago—who was also the current Chen Ji and Demonic Path Commander. "Eye of Heavenly Dao..." Chen Ji's voice was ice-cold. "So you were the one most afraid of us merging."
